estimates.assumptions: 3 medium Braeburn apples; each assumed at ~110 g raw edible portion after peeling/quartering/coring (standard medium apple weight ~140-160 g whole, ~20-25% loss from peel/core).
4 tbsp red wine jelly; 1 tbsp jelly ≈ 20 g (typical density for fruit jelly/jam). Calories estimated from similar reduced red wine + jam sugar recipes (high sugar content).
100 ml crème fraîche; density ≈ 0.98 g/ml for full-fat crème fraîche. Standard full-fat value used as no 'light' specified.
3 cardamom pods; each pod ≈ 0.6-0.7 g (standard whole pod weight). Modest seasoning amount; only seeds contribute meaningfully but whole pods weighed.
